commit.message:
DEV: disable assertion rewriting in the xp marker checker (#26284)

platformdirs 4.12.0 introduced an automatically registered pytest plugin.
The `xp` marker checker (`spin check --xp-markers`) imports all public
SciPy modules before calling `pytest.main()`, so `scipy.datasets` has
already imported `platformdirs` when `pytest` attempts to mark it for
assertion rewriting. This emits a `PytestAssertRewriteWarning`, which our
warnings-as-errors policy makes the check fail both locally and in CI.

Fix: use `--assert=plain`. The checker is collection-only, so assertion
rewriting isn't needed or useful.

The regular test suite can't hit the same problem, because `scipy`
is always imported before `platformdirs`.

Fixes the failures that showed up in CI in the last 12 hours.
